name: docker-containers
description: A /docker pane showing `docker ps` (ID, image, command, created, status, ports, names), refreshed every 2 seconds while open; pick the Docker context, whether to include stopped containers and the interval in the plugin's settings

context.title: Docker context
context.description: The docker context to list (docker --context). Empty follows DOCKER_HOST, then your current context (docker context use).

all.title: Include stopped containers
all.description: Also list exited and created containers (docker ps --all).

refresh_seconds.title: Refresh interval (seconds)
refresh_seconds.description: How often the pane refreshes while it is open.
